Name: Visual Crossing Expanded Overhaul
Author: K2sync
Description:
A complete redraw of very nearly all the characters in Stardew Valley Expanded to match portraits and retain a consistent art style between sprites. (Majority of which are edits to make the nose lower in sideview.)

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1942/]Visual Crossing Sprite Overhaul [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4615/]Visual Crossing Portrait Overhaul[/url] is not required, but recommended. Features sprites specifically for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger.[/url]

If you have a suggestion for an alt or an error to report, please do!
